primary_estimand.name: whole_route_phase_variance_ratio
primary_estimand.role: descriptive reproduction/extension of published convergence, not independent confirmation

robustness.name: within_year_phase_retention
robustness.formula: OLS slope year-centered DFP_End ~ year-centered DFP_Start

actuator_bridge.role: source-data reproduction of signed compensation, not new mechanism discovery

forbidden_claims: variance contraction alone proves individualized feedback
estimate K, g, phi, r or D_eff without independent identification
claim PAYOFF-B discovered mule-deer temporal phase sense or bidirectional compensation
treat early/mid/late group summaries as independent evidence for the continuous individual-level funnel
retune frozen GEB V2 or any preregistered result
interpretation_rule: The audit can establish the magnitude and robustness of the published start-to-end phase funnel in continuous animal-year data and connect it descriptively to signed actuators. It cannot by itself distinguish feedback from measurement error, selection, passive retention, or other open-loop mechanisms.
